format: html

## Data Import

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

lobster_traps <- read_csv(
  "[https://pasta.lternet.edu/package/data/eml/knb-lter-sbc/77/8/66dd61c75bda17c23a3bce458c56ed84](https://pasta.lternet.edu/package/data/eml/knb-lter-sbc/77/8/66dd61c75bda17c23a3bce458c56ed84)"
) %>% 
  mutate(TRAPS = na_if(TRAPS, -99999))
#| label: plot-traps

lobsters_traps_summarize <- lobster_traps %>% 
  group_by(SITE, YEAR) %>% 
  summarize(TOTAL_TRAPS = sum(TRAPS, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(
  data = lobsters_traps_summarize,
  aes(x = YEAR, y = TOTAL_TRAPS, color = SITE)
) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Total Lobster Traps by Site Over Time",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Total Number of Traps",
    color = "Site"
  ) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
